title: "It Comes in Notebooks": Changes and Challenges when Operationalizing ML Prototypes
abstract: arXiv:2609.22903v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Machine learning practitioners commonly prototype models in computational notebooks before transitioning them to automated production systems. Despite its prevalence, the concrete engineering work involved in this transition and the software quality concerns that motivate it remain insufficiently characterized. We report on a qualitative study based on semi-structured interviews with 13 ML practitioners from industry and academia. Using reflexive thematic analysis, we identify 23 engineering changes organized into five themes: code restructuring, data pipeline development, testing & validation, pipeline automation, and monitoring & observability. We also identify 20 software quality attributes across the ML development lifecycle and map them to the engineering changes. translated_title: “它是以Notebook形式呈现的”：机器学习原型运营化过程中的变化与挑战
translated_abstract: 摘要：机器学习从业者通常先在计算笔记本中构建模型原型，然后再将其迁移到自动化生产系统中。尽管这一做法十分普遍，但这一过渡所涉及的具体工程工作以及促使其发生的软件质量关注点仍未得到充分刻画。我们报告了一项定性研究，该研究基于对来自工业界和学术界的13名机器学习从业者的半结构化访谈。通过反身性主题分析，我们识别出23项工程变更，并将其归纳为五个主题：代码重构、数据管道开发、测试与验证、管道自动化，以及监控与可观测性。我们还识别出贯穿机器学习开发生命周期的20项软件质量属性，并将它们映射到这些工程变更上。我们研究发现中一个反复出现的模式是：计算笔记本将监督职责外部化给人类从业者，并将成本推迟到运营化阶段才成为必须承担的义务……
tldr: 该研究通过对13名工业界与学术界机器学习从业者的访谈，首次系统刻画了将Notebook中的ML原型迁移到自动化生产系统所需的23项工程变更（归纳为五大主题）及20项软件质量属性的映射关系，并揭示计算笔记本会将监督责任转嫁给人类从业者、把成本推迟到运营化阶段才显现。
en_tdlr: Through semi-structured interviews with 13 ML practitioners, this study systematically characterizes the 23 engineering changes (organized into five themes) and 20 software quality attributes involved in operationalizing notebook-based ML prototypes, revealing that computational notebooks externalize oversight to human practitioners and defer costs to the operationalization stage.
